normative_notice: Entries induce candidate target-project types only. Target-project instructions, schemas, examples, validators, consumers, and tests must confirm every selected object, operation, and field.

entry_semantics.required_semantic_fields: Minimum fields when the family is selected; target evidence may refine names and add fields.
entry_semantics.conditional_fields: Fields included only when target evidence or consumers require them.
entry_semantics.invariants: Claims that every selected representation must preserve.
entry_semantics.allowed_provenance: Permitted Prism provenance candidates; actual constructors and source evidence must justify selection.
entry_semantics.allowed_assurance: Upper bounds and conditions, never assurance inferred from vocabulary alone.
entry_semantics.evidence_cues: Source signals that justify investigating the candidate family, not proof that it applies.
entry_semantics.anti_cues: Patterns that indicate conflation, vagueness, or epistemic overclaiming.

global_invariants: Use nominal domain-and-epistemic names instead of Input, Output, Data, Item, ReasoningResult, or CritiqueResult.
Do not represent hypotheses, evidence, findings, objections, decisions, or recommendations as List[String].
Separate statement tokens, propositions, claims, observations, and evidence relations.
Separate judgments, recommendations, decisions, and actions.
A rank is relative to candidates, criteria, evidence snapshot, and ranking method; it is not truth.
Every selected field has a trace to target-project evidence or an explicit reviewed decision.
Operational failure is distinct from epistemic status.
Every epistemic occurrence in the to_prism conversion profile returns Generated[T]; stronger provenance or assurance requires a separate material boundary.
Reasoning occurrences and skills are many-to-many; neither count determines the other.

type_budget.rule: Use the smallest nominal type set that preserves distinctions visible in target-project examples and consumers.
keep_as_a_field_when: representation is carried but not independently consumed
detail does not change workflow behavior or assurance
type_budget.extension_rule: Start coarse, record unresolved evidence, and split only when a new target case demonstrates an observable distinction.

reasoning_granularity.unit: One independently meaningful typed epistemic commitment, not one skill, prompt, agent, file, or model call.
reasoning_granularity.extension_rule: Change occurrence boundaries only when new target evidence makes one of the split or merge conditions observable.

example_derived_boundary_seeds.grounding: libs/mathformer SymPy pipeline; keep representations as fields unless independently consumed

inference_classes.meaning: A conclusion follows under an explicit formal system and rules.
inference_classes.does_not_establish: Truth of premises; Proof requires the accepted checker.

inference_classes.meaning: Domain content, evidence relevance, or a material policy supports a revisable conclusion.
Extraction or formalization maps one representation to another.
A named symbolic procedure transforms or solves a mathematical representation.
inference_classes.does_not_establish: Equivalence or completeness beyond the performed checks.

input_object_families.meaning: A concrete linguistic token in a source artifact or communication.
invariants: Statement identity depends on occurrence and attribution, not only normalized text.
allowed_provenance: Evidence[DomainStatement] when observed from an attributable source
allowed_assurance: Validated only for explicit syntactic/schema predicates
anti_cues: treating quoted text as proved content

input_object_families.meaning: Truth-evaluable content independent of any one wording.
invariants: A proposition is not a runtime Bool and is not identified by claimant.
allowed_assurance: Supported[P]
Proof[P]
anti_cues: using raw text identity as proposition identity
repository_candidate_examples: informal logic: premise and conclusion propositions

input_object_families.meaning: A proposition asserted by an accountable actor in a context.
invariants: Claim attribution remains available even when several claims express the same proposition.
allowed_assurance: Support/proof attaches to the proposition, not automatically to the act of claiming
anti_cues: assertion treated as evidence of its own content

input_object_families.meaning: A method-bound record of measurement or observation.
invariants: An observation is not evidence for a proposition until a relevance relation is declared.
allowed_assurance: Validated for method/schema conformance; Supported only after relation to a proposition

input_object_families.meaning: A proposition provisionally accepted without establishing it in the current workflow.
invariants: An assumption is never silently upgraded to evidence or proof.
allowed_assurance: No implied assurance

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: An attributable observation/artifact related to a target proposition under a relevance rule or policy.
invariants: The same source object may have different relevance to different propositions.
Generated content is not evidence merely because it is useful.
allowed_assurance: Supported[P] under a named MaterialPolicy
repository_candidate_examples: release readiness: observed checks materially support readiness

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: A testable candidate explanation, interpretation, prediction, or bridge.
invariants: Candidate status does not imply plausibility or support.
allowed_assurance: No implied assurance; later evidence may support/defeat its proposition

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: Ordered hypothesis assessments under an explicit rule and evidence snapshot.
invariants: Ranking retains the complete candidate set.
Bare score is forbidden.
Top rank is not truth or validation.
allowed_assurance: Validated only for ranking-rule conformance; no automatic support for top hypothesis

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: A structured assessment of a named target under critic standards.
invariants: No-issue result is bounded by method and scope.
One finding does not refute the whole target.
allowed_provenance: Evidence-backed judgment, according to actual method
allowed_assurance: Validated for structural conformance only unless stronger grounds exist

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: One reason against accepting a target claim, inference, assumption, or decision.
invariants: An objection may remain open, answered, sustained, or withdrawn.
allowed_assurance: No implied refutation

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: Information that rebuts a conclusion or undercuts its warrant.
invariants: Defeater kind is Rebutting or Undercutting and affected scope is explicit.
allowed_assurance: Material defeat under declared policy; proof only with kernel term

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: A concrete admissible witness violating a universal claim or invariant.
invariants: None found records bounded search, not proof of absence.
allowed_assurance: Proof only if formalized and kernel checked

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: An evaluator's assessment under an explicit standard.
invariants: Judgment does not authorize action.
allowed_assurance: Validated for rule conformance; Supported when material policy applies

invariants: Decision is not execution and requires authority.
allowed_provenance: Evidence when observed from decision system
allowed_assurance: Validated for authority/policy conformance when validator exists

invariants: Recommendation does not commit the addressee and does not execute.
allowed_assurance: Validated for policy conformance when explicit

intermediate_and_output_object_families.meaning: A requested, planned, attempted, or completed intervention.
invariants: Requested/planned/attempted/completed states are distinct.
Effects cannot be fabricated from a decision.
allowed_assurance: Validated for preconditions; Verified only with appropriate proof
repository_candidate_examples: release readiness: deployment action after release decision

invariants: Operation kind follows the semantic transformation, not a prompt verb.
Operational steps are not mislabeled reasoning.
One skill may implement several operations and one operation may compose several skills.
Skill count and occurrence count are independent.
allowed_assurance: Generation establishes production only
Evidence/computation/validation/support/proof require separate material constructors and grounds
anti_cues: inferring method solely from skill name
opaque model call for an entire workflow

invariants: No rank/support/truth implied
Best available explanation is not proof
Ranking does not generate candidates or validate winner
No winner without rule
Finding scope remains explicit
Not exhaustive by default
Does not adjudicate falsity or negate unrelated claims
Does not establish individual correctness or deterministic calibration
Provenance and dissent are retained
Recommendation is not an authorized decision or execution

material_operations.result: Evidence[T] or ordinary typed result according to the actual source/method
Validated[value: T, P(value)] or typed validation failure

invariants: A finding has a scoped target.
No-issue-found records bounded search and is not proof of absence.
Critique, objection, defeater, and counterexample remain distinct.
allowed_provenance: Generated in the to_prism epistemic conversion profile
allowed_assurance: No assurance from criticism alone
Validation/support/proof require later explicit material boundaries

skill_composition_patterns.confirmation_rule: Adopt only roles and fields evidenced in the target project.

invariants: Attempts are bounded.
Feedback changes visible state.
Exhaustion is not success.
skill_composition_patterns.confirmation_rule: Target evidence must establish criteria, bound, state transition, and acceptance rule.

invariants: Material support is not proof.
Recommendation, decision, and deployment are separate.
skill_composition_patterns.confirmation_rule: Target evidence must establish observations, policy, authority, and effect capability.
